summary: Satellite office workstation install and secure courier for contractor SSD and peripherals
description:
Issue summary: New contractor starts at the NYC satellite site and requires a pre-assembled sit-stand workstation, monitor arm, and a secure inbound shipment for a company-owned NVMe SSD (encrypted) plus mouse/keyboard.

Impact: If we miss the assembly and secure courier pickup window the contractor cannot start productive work on Monday. The SSD contains sensitive customer data (encrypted at rest) and requires chain-of-custody handling and signed receipt.

Environment: NYC satellite office (Suite 4B), standard perimeter access. Workstation will be placed at hotdesk #14 reserved for contractor. Badge activation for visitor contractor is needed for 7 days.

Steps to complete (high level):
1) Facilities to assemble sit-stand desk and mount monitor arm; verify cable management and attach anti-theft tether.
2) Inventory to label peripherals and record asset tags; SSD serialized as company asset AZ-SSD-2147.
3) Security to enable temporary badge (Contractor ID: C-1987) with timebox 2026-03-15 to 2026-03-21 and MFA token provisioning.
4) Shipping team to arrange secure courier (door-to-door, signature required, optional tamper-evident packaging) for inbound SSD from vendor; confirm tracking and ETA.
5) On delivery day, on-site rep (Marco Nguyen) to sign chain-of-custody form and confirm SSD is imaged/verified by IT.

Attachments/refs: Slack thread #facilities-nyc, confluence runbook 'satellite-onboard-workstation-v2' (https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/OPS/Satellite+Onboard+Workstation+v2).
steps_to_complete: Order and stage sit-stand desk (model: Ergotek S3) and monitor arm (ErgoArm-2) by 2026-03-13
Pre-label company assets and place asset tag sticker on SSD enclosure (AZ-SSD-2147)
Package vendor SSD in tamper-evident bag and mark shipment as 'SECURE: signature required'
Book courier pickup for 2026-03-14 morning window (preferred) with tracking to be returned by EOD
Enable temporary badge C-1987 and add access to Floor 4 between 08:00-19:00 for 2026-03-15 to 2026-03-21
On arrival, verify SSD serial and image via IT imaging station; upload confirmation to ticket
investigation_notes: Confirmed vendor can dispatch SSD with tamper-evident packaging; lead time 24 hours
Seat availability: hotdesk #14 reserved but monitor arm mount requires desk surface cross-check (supports up to 30mm thickness) -> confirmed OK
Temporary badge provisioning requires HR approval record; HR (Nina Soto) emailed; auto-approval flow expected within 4 hours
No past incidents for this contractor; asset AZ-SSD-2147 was issued previously to a different team and flagged as returned in inventory on 2025-11-02
